text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French defence minister Charles Millon meets his Portuguese and Italian counterparts at a base of the NATO-led Stabilisation Force (SFOR) in the Sarajevo suburb of Rajlovac.
- Directors of the Bosnian postal company meet with outgoing Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic to discuss $60 million project to begin restoring the country's communication and postal systems.

- Bosnia exists, but the question remains whether the state will be formed by a just and lawful government, Cardinal Vinko Puljic, the head of the Bosnian Roman Catholic Church says in an interview in paper's weekly edition Svijet.
- Outgoing Bosnian Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic says installing of Internet system in Bosnia is crucial for country's communications.
